Privacy Policy

MI Controls Jobs is operated by MS ECOM LLC, Troy, Michigan. This page explains, in plain language, what information the site collects and what we do with it. Questions or requests: mitchell@msecomllc.com.

What we collect

  • Employer job-post submissions. When an employer submits the post-a-job form, we receive the company name, contact name and email, the job details (title, city, pay range, shift, description), the apply URL or email, and any referral code entered.
  • Job-alert signups. When a candidate subscribes to the weekly job alerts, we receive their email address.
  • Payments. Paid posts are checked out through Stripe. We never receive or store your full card number — Stripe processes the payment and confirms it to us.
  • Basic usage data. We count views of job pages so employers can see how their posts perform, and we use advertising measurement tools described below.

How we use it

  • To publish job posts and operate the board.
  • To send the weekly job-alert email to subscribers, and employer reports (views and applicants) to employers about their own posts.
  • To run the referral program — a referral code is credited only when the employer who received it tells us, or enters it on the form.
  • To respond when you contact us.

Job posts are public by design: the job details and apply link an employer submits are shown on the board. An employer's contact email is used for account communication and is not published as part of the listing beyond the apply link or email the employer provides for applications.

Cookies and advertising measurement

We advertise on Microsoft Advertising (Bing), and this site carries Microsoft's UET measurement tag. That tag uses cookies and similar technologies to measure how our ads perform — for example, whether a visit from an ad led to a job post or an alert signup — so we can tell which ads work. This measurement data is processed by Microsoft under its own privacy terms. You can opt out of Microsoft's personalized advertising at Microsoft's privacy settings, and most browsers let you block or clear cookies at any time.

We don't sell personal information

We do not sell, rent, or trade personal information to third parties for their marketing. Information is shared only with the service providers needed to run the site (such as our email and payment providers), and only for the purposes described above.

Your choices and requests

Every job-alert email includes an unsubscribe option, and unsubscribing stops the alerts. To ask what information we hold about you, or to have it corrected or deleted, email mitchell@msecomllc.com and we will take care of it. If this policy changes in a material way, we will update this page and note the new date below.
